body:
Not for the light hearted. Took this trip 3 times now. Extreme use of nitrous oxide from big industrial bottles with big doses of LSD. Time shifting, enviroment shifting, blending with other planes, Sober people being able to see participants shapeshift, Sober poeple (sitters) being able to trip just by being near, or in the room. Mental telepathy between people taking same super trip. Information able to be sent back and forth between super trippers in chunks. Experiences sent, not thoughts. Awsome. Founded a chuch after this. Met King David, a couple different aliens, Lord Vishnu. One must be careful in that one does not panic. This is a HUGE endevour.
